Ext.title: Ext

schema.description: A community tells a subject that an administrator reduced their administrative authority — revoked their entry, demoted their role, or narrowed what it allows — on whose authority, when, why, and whether anyone else agreed. Unsolicited: the subject did not ask. The removal of a member is vtc/members/removal-notice; this is the reduction of authority, which may leave the subject a member.

agreement.description: Whether a party other than the deciding administrator and the subject agreed. `consented`: the reduction ran on the consent of at least one other administrator. `unopposed`: nobody other than the decider and the subject held the authority to consent, so the decider's own re-authentication was the only gate. The distinction is the subject's evidence that a reduction no third party reviewed happened.

code.description: What happened. `revoked`: the subject's access control entry was removed. `demoted`: its role was changed to one with a lower ceiling. `narrowed`: its role stayed and what it allows was reduced.

decidedAt.description: When the reduction took effect — not when the notice was sent.

decidedBy.description: DID of the administrator who decided. The community itself is the document's issuer.

did.description: The subject whose authority was reduced — the notice's recipient. Carried in the payload as well as the envelope so that a forwarded notice still names its subject.

previousRole.description: The role the subject held before the change.

reason.description: The deciding administrator's stated reason, verbatim. Absent when none was given; absent and empty are different claims.

resultingRole.description: The role the subject holds after the change. Absent exactly when `code` is `revoked`.

schema.title: VTC Members Authority-Reduced Notice — payload
